Bug_Details: Unit mismatch when decomposing a Duration or Instant to call a  API
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when trying to convert a duration of minutes into seconds using the toSeconds() method of java.time.Duration.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case calculated the expected seconds by multiplying the given minutes by 60. When the buggy method `showBug` was called, it triggered the bug by returning the incorrect number of seconds. This caused the assertEquals statement to fail, triggering the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed successfully (OK (1 test)) without any assertion errors. This indicates that the bug was not triggered as the expected and actual results were equal (300 seconds), matching the expected minutes to seconds conversion.
